Electron transport chain.question: The _____ was Energy-producing metabolic pathway.

Many of the enzymes in the electron transport chain are embedded within the membrane.

Q passes electrons to Complex III (cytochrome bc1 complex; labeled III), which passes them to cytochrome c (cyt c).
